contexts.text: There are wonderful consociations in the other life...
Those who had consociated themselves are dispersed...
There is not the least difference which does not dissociate or consociate.
Hence it is evident how, in the other life, they are consociated, and how they are dissociated, according to perceptions.
Through mutual love all (in Heaven) are thus consociated by the Lord.
Heavenly consociations are according to lives, and never according to the thoughts which are not of the life.

All things there are most accurately consociated, in the Heavens according to all the differences of love to the Lord and of mutual love, and thence of faith; and in the Hells according to all the differences of cupidities, and thence of phantasies. AC 3642:end.
Hence is the consociation of man with the Angels (through the Word).
In the other life, all are consociated according to affections, and they who are consociated constitute a brotherhood.
The Societies in Hell are so instituted, that they act all together as one against good, thus are they kept consociated... But in the world, the good are consociated with the evil...
The Natural of love is the delight of consociation and conjunction.

Hence it follows, that in the other life all are consociated according to loves... They who are in love towards the neighbour and in love to God are consociated in Heaven, and they who are in the love of self and the love of the world are consociated in Hell.
(In Mars) those who agree in disposition are consociated... They said that their consociations are delightful...
In the statutes which follow, it is indicated who can be consociated, and who cannot. AC 8001:end.
The paschal supper represented the angelic consociations in Heaven...
By its being eaten in one house are signified the consociations of concordant goods, so as to make together one good. To eat the passover = to be consociated.
In the Hells there is consociation through evils, as in the Heavens through goods, but the consociation in the Hells is like that of thieves.
All the consociations in the other life take place according to spheres...
Consociation as to the Divine celestial state. Signified.
The reason the flesh of the sacrifices was to be eaten, was in order that there might be represented... consociation through love...
It is according to order, that in the other life all are consociated according to the life...
In the other life, all are consociated according to the life of the will, not according to the life of the understanding...
The truths with which good can be conjoined are such as are confirmed and as are also consociated with many others...
The wings being erected the one to the other, represented the consociation of all things in the Divine.
Such is the case with consociations in the Spiritual World.
The goods and truths with man mutually love each other, and according to loves acknowledge each other, and thus consociate together.
No consociation with such. Signified. AC 9252.
In the other life, all are consociated according to good and thence truth...

No one is permitted to speak with Angels and Spirits as a Spirit and Angel, unless he is such that he can be consociated with them as to faith and love; nor can he be consociated unless the faith and love be directed to the Lord...

(In the Spiritual World) all are consociated according to loves; they who are in love to the Lord from the Lord, are consociated in the inmost Heaven; they who are in love towards the neighbour from the Lord, are consociated in the middle Heaven; they who are in the obedience of faith, that is, who do truth for the sake of truth, are consociated in the ultimate Heaven; but they who are in the love of self and of the world... are consociated in Hell. HH 479. TCR 569.
Such is the consociation of the Angels with man.
Spirits are consociated and dissociated according to affections and thence thoughts.
Those who are in the same Heaven can be consociated with any who are there; yet the delights of consociation are according to the affinities of the good in which they are.
Hence it is evident, that good consociates all in the Heavens... Yet it is not the Angels who thus consociate themselves together, but the Lord, from Whom is the good...
Similar are the consociations in the Heavens; they are conjoined there according to uses in a like form.
There are also Angels who do not live consociated... These are the best of the Angels.
On the form of Heaven, according to which are the consociations and communications there. Chapter.

In Heaven all are consociated according to spiritual affinities, which are those of good and truth in their own order; it is so in a whole Heaven, in each Society, and in each house... Similarly consociated are the goods and truths which make wisdom and intelligence with every Angel...
Man was so created that he might have conjunction with the Lord, but only consociation with the Angels. Explained. AR 818:end.
At first, Spirits can be consociated with those who are like them in externals.
Through the sense of the letter of the Word there is conjunction with the Lord, and consociation with the Angels. General article. AR 851, Signified.
They are consociated according to discrete degrees...
Man is consociated with Angels in Heaven, and at the same time he is consociated with men in the world.
Consociation through love and friendship. Signified.
Every man who is in the goods and truths of the Church from the Word is consociated with the Angels of Heaven...
The Church which is a Church from the Word... is in consociation with Heaven, and in conjunction with the Lord.
These two states (of Spirits and men) are consociated solely through correspondences, and consociation through correspondences causes them indeed to be together in affections, but not in thoughts.
All in the Heavens are consociated according to the affinities and propinquities of love.
As to his spirit, every man is consociated with his like in the Spiritual World... See TCR 561:end.

This is the state of the consociation of Spirits and men. I said, I know that all here are consociated with their like in the natural world. Example(s)... This is the state of the consociation of Spirits and men.
This delight of the Angels (in the Word) is communicated to the man, and makes consociation... For the sake of this consociation with the Angels... the Holy Supper was instituted...
Under Communion, see these references. TCR 607.
Sympathies and antipathies are nothing but exhalations of affections... All conjunctions and consociations in the Spiritual World are effected according to them.
With every man there is a consociate Spirit...
His soul then comes into the Spiritual World... and is consociated with his like.
Through victory over the external man he becomes spiritual, and is then consociated by the Lord with the Angels of Heaven.
On consociations according to affections and cupidities, also appearances and phantasies. DMin 4730.
After death, souls do not at once come into their own consociations. Explained.
Truth is to be consociated with good, and when it is consociated it becomes a brother.
